budget_items.what_was_recorded: Unitil said it currently has $400,000 allocated for all communities it serves and that the new budget would triple vegetation management funding to $1.4 million.
budget_items.quote: per john they currently have $400,000 allocated for all communities that they serve and with the new budget, will be tripling the amount allocated for vegetation management to $1.4 million.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Unitil proposes recovering $13,026,642 in December 2008 ice storm restoration expenses over seven years, with carrying charges; the minutes also refer to 13 million in storm costs.
budget_items.quote: $2,205,868 in annual recovery over a, seven-year period of $13,026,642 in expenses associated with the company's efforts

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Company seeks to increase annual electric distribution revenues by $7,149,627, made up of a $4,943,759 base deficiency and $2,205,868 storm cost recovery; the minutes give a rate impact of $0.01 621 per kWh offset by a transition charge reduction.
budget_items.quote: the company seeks to increase its annual electric distribution revenues by $7,149,627, which represents an 11.3 percent increase in current total electric operating revenues

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Attorney Epler said the shortfall is roughly 7%; the minutes say the average consumer would not see an increase.
budget_items.quote: according to attorney epler, it's roughly 7%.

budget_items.quote: this year the increase was capped overall to 6% for the next two years, and 7% going forward to 2040.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Employees pay 5% to 12% into the system; employer normal cost is 3.5%, compared with a 6.25% Social Security match.
